title: Pre-Specified Archive Invariance, Candidate Subsidiary Regularities, and Putative Split-Ledger Links in Inka Khipus
description:
Reproducible code, internal pre-specification protocol (PREREGISTRATION.md, frozen on 2026-11-27 without prior external timestamp), deviation log, and derived outputs for a two-phase study of Inka khipus across OKR v2.1.0 (n = 611) and disjoint KFG-only Excel workbooks (n = 36). Phase 1 reports internally pre-specified inter-archive invariance (primary modal color match and OKR numeric rank plus JSD robustness), explicit tabular outlier accounting (21/86), and a null result (0/30 BH-FDR) against five highland Textos Andinos schemas calibrated with BH-FDR and nominal power plus proxy controls. Phase 2 (exploratory) documents five candidate hierarchical regularities of subsidiary cords evaluated at the khipu level with blind KFG out-of-sample replication, regional archive variation across eight sites, and a descriptive 611 x 611 rare-number sweep (538 filtered pairs) surfacing a putative three-khipu Berlin split-ledger link (VA 42518 <-> VA 63038 b / VA 63038(B)) and a putative reversed physical duplicate (VA 24370(B) <-> VA 66834), both pending museum verification.
